text.p: These are the leading stories in the Zambian press on Tuesday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Zambia Consolidated Copper Mines announced that Binani Industries Ltd had won the bid for the company's Luanshya and Baluba mines.
- The Zambia National Oil Co has cut fuel prices by 23 kwacha, following a cut in value added tax to 17.5 percent from 20 percent.
- Opposition parties are divided over pre-meeting conditions they want set before multiparty talks with the government take place.
- The business community has welcomed a cut in value added tax, but said it would continue to lobby for further reductions.
- President Frederick Chiluba has commended Rwanda for helping refugees from the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
- Nurses at Zambia's biggest hospital have staged a sit-in protest to push for more pay.
